description.value: COBS Bread Highstreet is a franchise bakery in Abbotsford, part of the Australian-founded Bakers Delight group with over 190 Canadian locations. Every product is baked fresh on-site each day with no refrigeration or freezing, and unsold goods are donated to local charities at close. A touring cyclist can pick up fresh bread, loaves, buns, rolls, bagels, scones, cruffins, and savoury baked items.
